Name: QuickTransfer
Author: Jared
Description: Move many cards at once with a modifier key and right-click. Shift moves 5, Ctrl moves 10, Ctrl+Shift moves the whole stack (or half, or all but one). Adjust the amounts in game with Ctrl+Plus/Minus and Alt+Plus/Minus. Hold Caps Lock to widen a batch to every card in the container sharing the clicked card's tag (food by default). Hold Left Alt to move only cards at least half way to spoiling, and Prioritize Most Spoiled moves the stacks closest to spoiling first. Hold a modifier and press X to transfer without clicking, or Z to undo the last batch. Drain Matching Stacks continues into the same item's other slots, and cards that cannot pile do this by default. A batch stops with a notice if the container closes or you open another, and the overlay reports how many cards actually moved. Optional per-container keys switch bulk transfer off for a kind of container or remember an amount for it. Full Stack Mode, a middle-click trigger, one sound per batch and an English and Chinese overlay are also included. With Repeat Action installed, Shift+Plus/Minus changes only its repeat count. With Utility Belt installed, a batch never moves a card you locked there.
